subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should complete cron ownership reconciliation land in this slice, land atomically with a companion, or wait until the Claws RFC accepts the permanent lifecycle contract?
rationale: The defects require a permanent recovery and persistence owner, while the protected draft belongs to an RFC stack explicitly described as prototype evidence rather than an accepted compatibility contract.

options.title: Restack with full recovery
options.body: Include canonical schema ownership, declaration retry/adoption, and idempotent cleanup in this cron slice before review resumes.

options.title: Require an atomic companion
options.body: Keep this split only if a concrete reconciliation companion is reviewed and guaranteed to land with this PR.

options.title: Defer scheduler mutation
options.body: Keep portable cron declarations but postpone Gateway mutation until maintainers accept the lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Restack with full recovery
recommendation.body: Include canonical schema ownership, declaration retry/adoption, and idempotent cleanup in this cron slice before review resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current declarative cron contract and has the strongest recent history across cron durability and shared-state schema ownership.
